web-guide-idea-95.audience: Writers seeking constructive responses to original work.
web-guide-idea-95.offer: Create a supportive feedback circle with a clear critique method. Keep sharing voluntary and the group small enough for useful attention.
web-guide-idea-95.steps.0: Agree submission length and feedback boundaries.
web-guide-idea-95.steps.1: Give each writer a reading and response turn.
web-guide-idea-95.steps.2: Help them choose a revision to try next.
web-guide-idea-95.equipment: A phone and the writer’s own text; a shared document is optional with permission.
web-guide-idea-95.returnReason: Review revisions or new pieces, letting writers see how their craft develops.
web-guide-idea-95.promotion: Share the feedback format and a sample prompt, never private submissions.
